source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Review the original inspection report.
3. Assume that the evidence supported the report’s findings.
4. If you feel the test failed, document your reasons.
5. If you can’t decide if the test failed, document that.
6. Report the test using the guidance on this SOP.
7. Sign the report.

## Background

This SOP covers how to correctly record failed brake tests.

See this [PowerPoint slide](https://storage.googleapis.com/uoc-mvpi-libs/brake_test_fail.pptx) and the linked document.

If you are using this SOP with a paper-based system, there are forms available from the [Forms and Templates list](https://uoc-mvpi.github.io/training/guide//forms-and-templates) and links below.

### Fault Criteria

Noting that a vehicle’s brakes need servicing,
